publicationId.description: The prefixed ID of the publication object

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. The limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

cursor.description: **Cursor-based pagination (recommended)**: Use this opaque cursor token to fetch the next page of results. When provided, pagination will use cursor-based method which is more efficient and consistent than offset-based pagination.

page.description: **Offset-based pagination (deprecated)**: Page number for offset-based pagination. Please migrate to cursor-based pagination using the `cursor` parameter. If not specified, results 1-10 from page 1 will be returned.

order_by.description:
The field that the results are sorted by. Defaults to created.
`created` - The time the poll was created.
`name` - The name of the poll.

direction.description:
The direction that the results are sorted in. Defaults to asc.
`asc` - Ascending, sorts from smallest to largest.
`desc` - Descending, sorts from largest to smallest.

expand[].description:
Optionally expand the response to include additional data.
`stats` - Returns aggregate vote counts per choice and total completions.
`poll_responses` - Returns up to 10 most recent subscriber responses. Use /polls/{pollId}/responses for paginated access to all responses.
`trivia_answer` - Returns the correct answer for trivia-type polls.

post_id.description: Filter to only return polls that were embedded in the specified post. Accepts a prefixed post ID (e.g. `post_abc123`).

id.description: The prefixed ID of the poll.

description.description: An optional description of the poll.

created_at.description: The time the poll was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

poll_choices.description: The available choices for this poll.

id.description: The unique identifier of the poll choice.

label.description: The text label for this choice.

trivia_answer.description: The correct answer for trivia-type polls. Only included when `expand[]=trivia_answer` is specified and the poll is of type trivia.

completions.description: The total number of responses to this poll.

vote_counts.description: A map of poll choice labels to the number of votes each choice received.

total_responses.description: Total number of responses to this poll. Only included when `expand[]=poll_responses` is specified.

poll_responses.description: Up to 10 most recent subscriber responses. Only included when `expand[]=poll_responses` is specified. Use /polls/{pollId}/responses for paginated access to all responses.

id.description: The unique identifier of the poll response.

subscription_id.description: The ID of the subscription that responded.

poll_choice_id.description: The UUID of the poll choice selected.

poll_choice_label.description: The text label of the poll choice selected.

created_at.description: The time the response was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

extended_feedback.description: Optional extended feedback provided by the subscriber.

post_id.description: The prefixed ID of the post where the response was collected. Only included when `expand[]=post` is specified.

post_title.description: The title of the post where the response was collected. Only included when `expand[]=post` is specified.

post_publish_date.description: The scheduled publication date of the post where the response was collected. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch. Only included when `expand[]=post` is specified. Null if the post is not yet scheduled.

limit.description: The limit placed on the results. If no limit was specified in the request, this defaults to 10.

page.description: **Offset pagination only**: The page number the results are from. Only present when using deprecated offset-based pagination.

total_pages.description: **Offset pagination only**: The total number of pages. Only present when using deprecated offset-based pagination.

has_more.description: **Cursor pagination only**: Indicates whether there are more results available after the current page. Only present when using cursor-based pagination.

next_cursor.description: **Cursor pagination only**: The cursor token to use for fetching the next page of results. This will be null if has_more is false. Only present when using cursor-based pagination.

total_results.description: The total number of results from all pages.
